events.description: Multiple individuals in yellow vests engage in mutual physical combat with riot police; pushing, shoving, and grappling are visible, including a man in a dark jacket being struck and pushed back by officers.

Sustained violent group clash between a crowd of protesters (many wearing yellow vests) and heavily equipped riot police, involving repeated pushing, use of shields, falling individuals, and chaotic movement across the street.

A person in a yellow vest is on the ground near police shields while officers appear to press down or strike toward them; the individual is in a vulnerable position with limited ability to defend themselves.

Large group of protesters in yellow vests confronts a line of riot police; physical pushing and shoving occurs, with objects (e.g., a yellow object) being thrown toward police. The scene shows collective violent unrest with active clashes between two groups.

A person wearing a yellow vest is on the ground, surrounded and restrained by multiple riot police officers who are kneeling and applying force; the individual appears helpless and unable to resist while being subdued. This constitutes abuse of a defenseless person.

Mutual physical combat observed between individuals in yellow vests and police officers: grappling, pulling, and striking motions occur in the central cluster (e.g., person in red vest engaged with officers). Not all contact is one-sided; some participants actively resist or strike back.

Multiple police officers in riot gear surround and physically restrain a person lying on the ground; the individual appears helpless and is being pinned down, with officers applying force including kneeling on the torso and limbs.

Large crowd of yellow-vested protesters and police engage in violent clashes in a public square; visible smoke (likely tear gas or stun grenades), people running, throwing objects, and chaotic movement indicate collective violent unrest.

Sustained violent unrest involving protesters in yellow vests and law enforcement, with heavy deployment of tear gas or smoke canisters, resulting in dense white smoke engulfing the street near the Arc de Triomphe. Individuals are seen moving rapidly, some throwing objects (e.g., f0–f5), while police in riot gear are positioned behind barriers (f0–f10). The scene evolves from localized smoke to widespread dispersion across Place Charles de Gaulle (f11–f15).

A group of riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields, body armor) is tightly clustered and advancing or holding a line on a city street, with some officers holding batons and one raising a baton as if preparing to strike; the posture and formation indicate active crowd control during unrest.

A large cloud of white smoke (consistent with tear gas or smoke grenades) rapidly fills an open plaza; police and individuals in yellow vests are seen dispersing, running, and taking cover, indicating active deployment of crowd-control agents during a violent confrontation.

Police in riot gear deploy tear gas or smoke canisters against a group of protesters, including individuals wearing yellow vests, resulting in a large cloud of white smoke spreading across the plaza; participants are seen running, retreating, and dispersing amid the smoke.

Large-scale violent unrest involving multiple individuals in yellow vests and police/riot officers, with widespread deployment of tear gas or smoke canisters causing dense white smoke across the street; participants are seen running, dispersing, and engaging in confrontational movement, consistent with a riot.

Intense deployment of tear gas or smoke in a public square, with multiple individuals (including some in yellow vests) running, crouching, or retreating through dense white smoke; police or security personnel visible moving through the cloud. This constitutes collective violent unrest involving crowd dispersal tactics and reactive movement.

Large group of protesters wearing yellow vests and law enforcement officers facing off across a street; smoke still present in background, indicating ongoing confrontation and tension. No active physical combat, but sustained standoff characteristic of riot conditions.
